title: Round 1 fixes — a full-screen error, and a themed dropdown for Pages

steps.headline: A screen that loaded nothing now shows a proper full-screen error.
steps.changed: Instead of a small red strip with the raw error text, the screen shows one box in the middle: what couldn't load, a reassuring line, the technical reason folded under Details, and a full-width Try again under it.
steps.notice: The same box is used on the Library and Pages screens (next steps), and it's the rule new screens get.
steps.risk: The raw message is now one click away under Details instead of always shown.

steps.path: Your library, when your plugins couldn't load
steps.headline: Your library: the same full-screen error.
steps.changed: "Couldn't load your installed plugins: <raw message>" becomes "Your installed plugins couldn't load" with "Nothing was removed.", Details, then Try again.
steps.notice: Your notes on round 1 also moved every error box's buttons below its Details fold, app-wide.

steps.path: Manage pages, when the list couldn't be read
steps.headline: Pages: the same full-screen error.
steps.changed: "The list of pages could not be read." in a strip becomes the centred box "Your pages couldn't load" with Try again.
steps.notice: No Details here: this failure has no extra reason to show.

steps.path: A Page's dropdown, opened — here the Week planner's Kind
steps.headline: Every Page's dropdown now opens the app's own themed list, never the browser's white one.
steps.changed: Pages keep writing a plain dropdown; the Pages kit swaps the list that opens for the app's look: theme colours and corners, the current choice filled, arrow keys and typing work. An action at the foot ("Add another kind…") sits under the tapered line, apart from the choices.
steps.notice: All existing Pages get it automatically (Home, Money, Week planner…), and the page-building skill now tells the assistant to use it.
steps.risk: Not checked on phone touch screens yet. Escape with a list open now closes only the list, like the browser's list did.
